title: heartland-synthetic: Synthetic heart-failure cohort generator with HEARTLAND risk variables
description: Python research package for synthetic heart-failure cohorts, software testing, and educational demonstrations. Includes modeled rural access, a legacy social-support proxy (not an ESSI implementation), the ten proposed HEARTLAND point criteria, AR(1) monthly simulations, assumed tier-indexed outcomes, and standalone REDCap and FHIR R4 collection exports. Model constants are simulation assumptions with background literature references, not an empirically calibrated or clinically validated model. Scoring input checks establish structural completeness, not physiologic plausibility or clinical eligibility. No real patient, personal, or health information should be supplied. The package is not a de-identification system and does not authorize patient care or claim regulatory or HIPAA status. Software, the preserved dataset v1.0.0, and the technical report have distinct version histories. The dataset's original provenance cites the v0.2.1 software archive, not the later v0.2.2 packaging release. The original runtime receipt is unavailable; byte-identical regeneration is not promised; a source version or draft metadata file is not evidence of external publication.
